creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_endless/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 and NumPy 2.5.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python). The output parent directory must exist.
patch: PCG64 seed 5513. Plucks: soft two-operator FM voice with a fast-decaying index and warm body, low root figure, mid eight-note wheel (three variants) and sparse high sparks, panned. Pad: four-partial sine voice with a detuned twin on a quiet open fifth (A2 and E3) with slow swell and 0.09 Hz breathing. 2.2 s seeded-noise reverb applied by circular FFT convolution, wet 0.38, so tails cross the loop boundary. Events and releases wrap modulo the loop. Master gain 1.2, nearest-even PCM16 quantization without dither.
tuning: A minor pentatonic (A C D E G), tonal center A, A4 = 440 Hz; pad A2+E3, plucks A2-E5 (MIDI 45-76)
register_note: Measured mono energy share: below 100 Hz -28.8 dB, 100-450 Hz -0.1 dB, 450-1600 Hz -15.8 dB, 1.6-5 kHz -33.3 dB, above 5 kHz -78.9 dB of total. Plucks stay below about 700 Hz fundamentals so the 1.6-5 kHz band stays open for the floor marker and the reward clinks.

floor_cycle.note: Four cycles of five bars, one bar per floor (1-based bars 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-20). Plucks add a voice each bar, then bar 5 of each cycle is a marker room: no pluck, only the quiet pad (about 8 dB below the floor bars by RMS, not silent). Frames are sample frames per channel; 35,280 per beat, 141,120 per bar.
floor_cycle.note_on_silence: The bed does not go silent for the bank-or-continue decision. The game should duck or stop it; the marker rooms and an open 1.6-5 kHz band leave room for the floor marker and sfx_reward either way.

loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: The pad's and reverb's tails across the final bar are still sounding at the final frame and continue into bar 1; frame 0 equals the continuation of frame 2822399.

verification.rebuild: Two independent render processes wrote to separate empty directories (together with the other bed and the eight SFX). Master WAVs, all SFX WAVs and the SFX ledger matched (diff -r).
verification.meter: FFmpeg 8.1.2 ebur128 (peak=true) on the master WAV; not the pinned 6.1.1 build, which this machine lacks. Re-measure on the pinned build in the packing step.
